evidenceDecision: useWorldObservation.test.ts moves HostsFilter.actions watch-revision and unavailable-only-filter policy to the actual observation hook on controlled time, with the real watchlist store and actual host projection. Runtime snapshots and service replies are synthetic inputs; older/missing admissions remain pending, current healthy counts survive an unavailable peer, and hidden peers cannot affect a selected scope. The real Inspector controller, useWorldVisualActions publication callback and actual CommandCombobox also require pending and unavailable-only detail text in the headless DOM after reopening the captured menu; this proves feedback presence, not browser geometry or focus. The retained desktop/phone browser case verifies fresh watch counts and unavailable-host feedback render in the actual Actions menu. All other Actions and Town cases remain. This adds consumer evidence without replacing service admission, transport or browser focus/routing checks. Runtime retirement and observation epochs establish producer boundaries; real watchlist tests enforce exact identities, bounded/idempotent admission and old-revision/reconnect behavior.
